precepts.text: They refused to hearken, pulled away the shoulder, and stopped their ears, ignoring the word the way our people do today.
precepts.point: Even when He pitied us and provided everything, bearing us on His wings, we rebelled and vexed His Holy Spirit, so He turned to be our enemy.

note.label: Psalm 55: Cast Thy Burden Upon the Lord

precepts.why:
“But they refused to hearken, and pulled away the shoulder, and stopped their ears, that they should not hear.” That is having no changes. They refused to hearken, pulled away the shoulder and stopped their ears, ignoring the word the way our people do today.

Because there was no change and no repentance, they feared not God, and the Most High who abideth of old heard and afflicted them. He carried us all the days of old and we stopped our ears, so he turned to be our enemy.

points: In the fourth year of king Darius, in the fourth day of the ninth month, even in Chisleu, the word of the Lord came unto Zechariah.

note.label: Zechariah 7: Did Ye at All Fast Unto Me?

points: They sent men to pray before the Lord, and to ask the priests and the prophets, Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?

note.label: Zechariah 7: Did Ye at All Fast Unto Me?

points: When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh month, even those seventy years, did ye at all fast unto me, even to me?

note.label: Zechariah 7: Did Ye at All Fast Unto Me?

points: And when ye did eat, and when ye did drink, did not ye eat for yourselves, and drink for yourselves?

note.label: Zechariah 7: Did Ye at All Fast Unto Me?

points: Should ye not hear the words which the Lord hath cried by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity?

note.label: Zechariah 7: Did Ye at All Fast Unto Me?

points: Execute true judgment, and shew mercy and compassion every man to his brother.

note.label: Zechariah 7: Did Ye at All Fast Unto Me?

points: Oppress not the widow, nor the fatherless, the stranger, nor the poor; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart.

note.label: Zechariah 7: Did Ye at All Fast Unto Me?

points: But they refused to hearken, and pulled away the shoulder, and stopped their ears, that they should not hear. They made their hearts as an adamant stone, lest they should hear the law and the words which the Lord of hosts sent in his spirit by the former prophets.

note.label: Zechariah 7: Did Ye at All Fast Unto Me?

points: As he cried, and they would not hear; so they cried, and I would not hear, saith the Lord of hosts. I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not, and the land was desolate after them, and they laid the pleasant land desolate.
